28371: The substantial protagonist of the manga, who has long red hair. She behaves like an Edokko and speaks in a masculine tone of Edo speech, but she is actually from Tokushima Prefecture. She acts tsukkomi and often says "Don't ask a trifling question! (Tsuman'nē koto Kiku na yo!?
28372: A girl with cream-colored hair who likes cats and often pretends to be cute in front of others. Her name is a pun on Hello Kitty and Kigurumi.
30559: A ponytailed girl with purple hair who is a lucky girl and leads a carefree life. The author introduces her as the true protagonist of the manga. Her name is a pun on bouhatei ("breakwater") and Tetrapod.
30560: A girl with glasses and green hair who is a cool-headed and strong girl. Her name is a pun on the phrase "cool beauty" and gankyou ("glasses").
30561: A girl with straight black hair who is very good at acting, but is an unlucky girl and is very emotionally unstable. Her name is perhaps a pun on anrakushi ("Euthanasia") and kukuru ("to hang").
73683: An "annoying" side character who appears in the last episode.
